YouTube channels and their analytics, and Google Business Profiles.

## Connect accounts

Each person connects their own YouTube account in the Gateway, once, and every app that asks uses it. Apps never see the tokens. [How connecting works](/docs/connect-oauth)

The redirect URI to register, with your Gateway's address (like `apps.example.com`):

```text
https://<your gateway>/connect/youtube/callback
```

Its own Google Cloud project, apart from google-workspace's: YouTube's scopes need their own verification. Not yet tried against a live connect.

1. Open [console.cloud.google.com](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials) and create an OAuth app (also called a client or an integration).
2. Add the redirect URI above.
3. Copy the client ID and client secret. The secret is often shown only once.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the client ID and secret:

```bash
everyapp provider add youtube
```

Or add it in **Manage workspace → Providers**.

### Use it in an app

```ts
capabilities: {
  youtube: { access: "read", scopes: ["youtube.read"], why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

Apps ask for these scope sets:

| Set | Allows | Provider scopes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identity` | Google account (who you are) | `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile`, `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email` |
| `youtube.read` | YouTube channels and analytics (read) | `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly`, `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/yt-analytics.readonly` |
| `youtube.write` | YouTube channels (upload and manage) | `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube`, `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload`, `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.force-ssl` |
| `business.write` | Google Business Profiles (read and post) | `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage` |

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show youtube` shows the client as set. Then open the account menu → **Connected accounts** → **Connect YouTube**.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20YouTube).
